text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon gives it her all ahead of the 
Oka Sho. Her Trainer comes up with various 
new training regimens just for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days of working hard together hand in 
hand...! As a result, Hishi Amazon 
achieved tremendous growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her Trainer's true dedication, 
Hishi Amazon placed deep trust in them as 
her partner. The Oka Sho was right around 
the corner—
